policy: Raw >=50% point vote retained; fewer than four is diagnostic only. No GT, padding, forced four-pair gate or changed source eligibility.

fields.selected_pair_count: Majority identity count before center/ring validation; null for split_unique because endpoint incidence can remain unresolved.
fields.generated_pair_count: Number of serialized candidate pairs, including geometrically invalid candidates; null if no serialized candidate.
fields.below_four_selected_pairs: Primary shortfall measure for paired/anchor routes; distinct from missing output or incorrect layout.
fields.e9z_subsets: All subsets of the existing eight records for n=2..8, not new workers or independent trials; >=50% has odd/even effects.
